lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical line segments visible. Spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-torso, with slightly narrower gaps between segments 9, 10, and 11 on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the ventral terminal of the 9th line (counting anterior to posterior), where the vertical stroke splits into two divergent paths.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and lines 10-11 (posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-height of the torso mass. Three distinct dashed segments are present below the 5th and 6th lines near the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast spots is localized on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, with highest density observed directly above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-posterior thigh align horizontally, creating a short geometric line segment parallel to the ventral plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Synthetic tracking collar (reddish-brown) with a large suspended pendant/bell attachment present around the neck.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent horizontal white bands ('socks') visible on the forelimbs at the carpal joints; distinct white chevron-like marking on the lower hind limb above the hoof.
